description: Approved plain-English text library for WebAudX user-facing copy, derived strictly from WebAudX PRD v1.0 Sections 12 and 13.

address.empty: Please enter the address of the page you want to review.
address.wrong_format: This doesn't look like a web address. Check for typing mistakes, such as yourwebsite.com.
address.unsupported_scheme: WebAudX can only review web pages that start with http:// or https://.

inspection.address_not_found: We could not find this website. Check the address and try again.
inspection.too_slow: The page took too long to respond. It may be slow or temporarily unavailable.
inspection.blocks_automated_checks: This website does not allow automated checks. You can still answer the questions yourself.
inspection.error_page: The page could not be loaded (error code [code]). Open the address in your browser to check it.
inspection.file_not_page: This address leads to a file rather than a web page, so it could not be reviewed.
inspection.too_large: This page is too large for WebAudX to review.
inspection.redirect_loop: This address keeps sending us elsewhere, so we could not reach the page.
inspection.very_little_text: We could read only a small amount of text on this page. Some websites load content in ways WebAudX cannot read, so some results are missing.
inspection.unexpected_error: Something went wrong while reviewing the page. Please try again in a few minutes.

progress.title: Checking your webpage...
progress.sampling: Checking internal links and usability elements...
progress.hint: This usually takes just a few seconds.

summary.title: Check Summary
summary.lead: Here is what our automated check measured on your webpage before you answer the questions.
summary.future_multipage_note: Checking multiple pages will come in a future version.
summary.about_report: WebAudX combines an automated check of one page with your answers. It is not a full or independent audit, and reflects the page on the date checked.

questionnaire.title: Usability Questions
questionnaire.lead: Answer these seven questions based on what a visitor experiences on your webpage.
questionnaire.evidence_heading: What we found on the page
questionnaire.no_evidence: No automated evidence needed for this question. Base your answer on your experience using the page.
questionnaire.unanswered_warning: Please answer all seven questions before continuing.
questionnaire.review_confirmation: All seven questions have been answered. Ready for Review & Report Generation.

questions.text: Can a first-time visitor quickly understand what this website is about?
Can a visitor understand what is being offered and who it is for?
Can a visitor easily find the information they are looking for?
Are the most important information and elements easy to notice?
Is it clear what the visitor should do next?
Can a visitor use the website without unnecessary confusion?
Is the website easy to understand and use on a mobile device?

account_and_branding.sign_in_link_expired: This sign-in link has expired. Request a new one.
account_and_branding.logo_too_large: This logo is larger than 1 MB. Please upload a smaller file.
account_and_branding.logo_type_not_allowed: Please upload a PNG, JPG, or SVG file.
account_and_branding.branding_not_saved: Your branding could not be saved. Your changes have not been lost. Please try again.

limits_and_system.daily_limit_reached: You have used your 10 checks for today. You can run another check after [time].
limits_and_system.service_unavailable: WebAudX is temporarily unavailable. Please try again shortly.
limits_and_system.pdf_failed: We could not create your PDF. Please try again.

notices.permission_warning: Please only review web pages you own or have permission to inspect.
notices.not_full_audit: WebAudX is a quick clarity and usability review, not a full technical audit.
notices.branding_scope: No account is needed to view or download standard reports. An account is only needed if you want custom agency branding.
